_about: spck.dev site claims register — every factual claim on the site that is not data-rendered from coverage/agent-coverage JSON must be registered here with evidence and a review-by date, or removed. Bootstrapped by ops/site-content-audit-2026-07.md (Phase 0 of the 2026-07-09 IA redesign). The manifest block is the bindable public source for product counts that do NOT exist in coverage JSONs (which count MUST rows, not checks); the site-freshness gate regenerates these numbers from the engine and goes RED on drift.

evidence._about: Honest EVIDENCE-CLASS split of the coverage matrix's CHECK bucket - the accounting totals above conflate a check kill-tested live against an independently-authored server with one that only validates our own fixture. This block names the split so the public claim cannot imply everything is wire-tested. Derived MECHANICALLY (never hand-labeled) by conformance/coverage/evidence.py from how each check actually runs, plus the recorded run in conformance/coverage/reach_report.json (which independent targets each wire check actually graded on). Classes: live-wire = graded on an independent server (flower golden / node reference); fixture-schema = our fixture validated through the OFFICIAL ucp-schema oracle; fixture-crypto = self-signed crypto primitive self-test; self-referenced = only our own fixture, no independent oracle or target (the fixture-circularity class we flag upstream as conformance#79, present in our own suite and counted here). Kill-tested + drift-gated by conformance/selfcheck/validate_evidence_class.py (run_suite gate evidence-class): if these numbers drift from a fresh matrix export, CI goes red.
